defects.statement: isAbsoluteURL treats any non-string input as an absolute URL: a missing or non-string url bypasses the scheme check and is returned as absolute instead of false.
combineURLs concatenates the base and the relative URL without the separator, so a relative path is glued to the last path segment of the base URL.
buildURL keeps the hash mark when stripping the fragment, so serialized params are appended after the fragment and never reach the server.
InterceptorManager.forEach no longer skips null slots, so it calls the iteration callback with null for every ejected interceptor.
start() assigns a new interval without clearing the existing timer, so calling start() twice leaks the first interval and it keeps firing.
store.save is not awaited before store.get, so the read can return the previous token instead of the value that was just saved.

pathNote: paths are relative to the analyzed scope (lib/)
